attempts.summary: Configured a tagged-VLAN trunk over the shared eth1 physical link across node1/node2/node3: node1 (OpenWrt) hosts 802.1q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (192.168.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (192.168.20.1/24) with dedicated firewall zones (forward=REJECT, no cross-zone forwarding rule) providing routing and isolation; node2 joined VLAN 10 via nmcli VLAN connection (192.168.10.2/24, gw .1); node3 joined VLAN 20 via nmcli VLAN connection (192.168.20.2/24, gw .1). Verified each host reaches node1 on its own VLAN while node2↔node3 traffic is refused (ICMP net-unreachable from node1's forward-reject policy). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot_id, restarted natively (reboot on OpenWrt, systemctl reboot on AlmaLinux), confirmed boot_id changed on each, and re-verified VLAN config persistence and connectivity/isolation after each restart.
